name: Monocrotophos
side_effects: Dizziness, sweating, breathing trouble, blurred vision, fainting.
first_aid: Move to fresh air. If swallowed, induce vomiting ONLY if conscious. Wash skin with soap/water. Rush to hospital. Atropine is antidote.
precautions: Wear full protective suit, gloves, mask, and boots. Do not spray against wind.
disposal: Crush empty bottle, bury deep in soil away from water sources. Do not burn.

name: Phorate
side_effects: Nausea, cramps, weakness, paralysis of respiratory muscles.
first_aid: Remove contaminated clothes. Wash eyes with water for 15 mins. Rush to doctor immediately.
precautions: Do not touch granules with bare hands. Use gloves and applicator.
disposal: Do not reuse container. Destroy and bury in landfill.

name: Dichlorvos (DDVP)
first_aid: Give plenty of water. Do not give milk/oil. Artificial respiration if breathing stops. Atropine required.
precautions: Use face shield. High vapor pressure - avoid inhaling fumes.
disposal: Triple rinse container, pour rinse water into tank. Puncture and bury container.

name: Profenofos
first_aid: Wash skin immediately. Flush eyes with water. Seek medical help.
precautions: Wear rubber gloves and mask. Dangerous to fish - do not wash in ponds.
disposal: Break bottle and bury away from habitation.

name: Cypermethrin
first_aid: Wash skin with soap. Vitamin E oil helps skin burning. Do not induce vomiting if swallowed.
precautions: Avoid contact with skin/eyes. Token to bees/fish.
disposal: Burn container in high temp incinerator or bury deep.

name: Chlorpyrifos
first_aid: Remove patient from area. Wash contaminated body parts. Atropine injection by doctor.
precautions: Highly toxic to birds and fish. Do not spray near water bodies.
disposal: Do not use empty container for food/water. Destroy and bury.

name: Imidacloprid
first_aid: Symptomatic treatment. No specific antidote. Wash thoroughly.
precautions: Toxic to honey bees. Do not spray during flowering season.
disposal: Triple rinse and bury in wasteland.

name: Mancozeb
first_aid: Wash eyes with water. Drink water to dilute. Consult doctor if irritation persists.
precautions: Wear mask to avoid inhaling dust. Wear gloves.

name: Glyphosate
first_aid: Flush eyes with water for 15 mins. Wash skin with soap.
precautions: Avoid spray drift to nearby crops. Wear boots and gloves.
disposal: Do not reuse container. Rinse and puncture.

name: Paraquat
side_effects: Severe lung damage, kidney failure, mouth ulcers.
first_aid: Administer activated charcoal or Fuller's earth immediately. Rush to hospital. Fatal if swallowed.
precautions: Never transfer to soft drink bottles. Fatal mistake!
disposal: Destroy container completely. Do not wash in river.

name: Acephate
first_aid: Induce vomiting. Wash skin properly. Consult doctor.
precautions: Do not spray during high sunlight.

name: Fipronil
first_aid: Wash with soap and water. Get medical attention if symptoms persist.
precautions: Very toxic to aquatic life with long lasting effects.
disposal: Collect spillage. Dispose of contents/container to hazardous waste collection point.

name: Thiamethoxam
side_effects: No specific symptoms known. Treat symptomatically.
first_aid: Wash skin thoroughly. Rinse eyes cautiously.
precautions: Dangerous to bees. Do not apply when bees are foraging.

name: Pendimethalin
first_aid: Wash skin with soap and water. Stains can be persistent.
precautions: Avoid contact with clothing as it stains heavily.

name: Carbendazim
first_aid: Wash off immediately. Consult doctor if pregnant.
precautions: Use protective clothing. Avoid generating dust.
